The '''71st [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' honored the best in film, television, radio and video-game writing of 2018. Winners were announced on February 17, 2019, at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]], [[Beverly Hills]], California and the Edison Ballroom, New York City, New York.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://awards.wga.org/wga-awards/awards-show-details |title=2019 Awards Timeline |access-date=December 8, 2018 |work=[[Writers Guild of America]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.wgaeast.org/award/2019/ |title=The 71st Writers Guild Awards |work=Writers Guild of America East |access-date=2018-12-08 |language=en-US}}</ref> The nominations for Television, New Media, Radio, News and Promotional Writing were announced on December 6, 2018.<ref>{{cite web |last1=McNary |first1=Dave |title=Writers Guild Awards Announces 2019 TV Nominees |url=https://variety.com/2018/tv/awards/writers-guild-awards-tv-nominations-handmaids-tale-succession-1203082582/ |website=Variety |date=December 6, 2018 |access-date=December 8, 2018}}</ref> The Theatrical, Documentary Screenplay and Videogame Writing nominees were announced on January 7, 2019.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=Writers Guild Film Nominations: 'Roma', 'Black Panther', 'Eighth Grade' & More |url=https://deadline.com/2019/01/2019-writers-guild-film-nominees-full-list-1202530533/ |website=Variety |date=December 6, 2018 |access-date=January 7, 2019}}</ref>
